advice_items.quote: buy dirt my father always told me buy dirt any kind of dirt you can buy
advice_items.summary_en: Buy dirt and invest in any real estate you can acquire.
advice_items.summary_zh: 尽一切可能购买土地投资房产

advice_items.quote: you got to fail before you get hungry to make yeah if you don't fail... you're not the hungry
advice_items.summary_en: You must experience failure first to develop the hunger needed to succeed.
advice_items.summary_zh: 先经历失败才能激发成功饥饿感

advice_items.quote: now it's a risk you know but stay with it and you'll be successful
advice_items.summary_en: Even when deals carry risk, stick with it persistently and you will succeed.
advice_items.summary_zh: 面对风险坚持到底才能获得成功

advice_items.quote: don't impulse it let them make it like you don't really want it or need it you can't be desperate to get a deal done... never settle on your first offer
advice_items.summary_en: Never appear desperate or impulsive in negotiations, be willing to walk away, and never settle on the first offer.
advice_items.summary_zh: 谈判切忌冲动，不急于成交也不妥协

advice_items.canonical_tag: Use Debt Wisely (Good Debt vs Bad Debt)
advice_items.quote: you got to use your own money don't use the banks cuz they're the only ones that make the money
advice_items.summary_en: Use your own capital rather than relying on banks, as banks are the ones who profit from lending.
advice_items.summary_zh: 尽量用自有资金，避免让银行赚走利润

guests.guest_name: New York City Real Estate Developer
guests.wealth_detail: $6M-$7M (or $67M) single-year personal income from business; owns ~20 companies; says 'close' to being a billionaire

advice_items.canonical_tag: OTHER:Get a Prenup & Protect Marital Assets
advice_items.quote: marriage is an important economic decision and you should be very careful about that... if you are Building Wealth you certainly have a prenuptual agreement
advice_items.summary_en: Treat marriage as a major economic decision and always get a prenuptial agreement when building wealth.
advice_items.summary_zh: 结婚也是经济决策，务必签婚前协议

advice_items.quote: I eventually lost it because I didn't convert it to a real money soon enough... sell too soon you never lose money selling too soon
advice_items.summary_en: Convert paper wealth into real cash early; you never lose money by selling too soon.
advice_items.summary_zh: 早点落袋为安，落袋的利润永远不会亏

guests.first_money_or_break: 曾在大型律所工作，并在1999-2000年互联网泡沫期间通过公司IPO股票期权获得1750万美元账面财富，但因6个月禁售期遇上市场崩盘最终仅以35万美元卖出，后因离婚损失数百万美元。
guests.guest_name: Former Big Law Attorney & Dot-Com Investor
guests.wealth_detail: Previously made $17.5M in paper IPO stock options (sold for $350K after crash); lost several million dollars in divorce; states he is no longer a millionaire

advice_items.quote: find a good wife to support you through the million businesses that you'll start
advice_items.summary_en: Find a supportive spouse who will stand by you through the many businesses you start.
advice_items.summary_zh: 找一位能支持你反复创业的贤内助

advice_items.quote: it just takes a whole lot more effort than what people realize cuz nobody else is going to do it for you... nobody's coming to save you
advice_items.summary_en: Entrepreneurship takes far more effort than people realize; you have to make it happen because nobody is coming to save you.
advice_items.summary_zh: 创业拼的是加倍付出，没人会来救你

advice_items.quote: I worked a job of the day running equipment and at night I went to school to learn how to be a project manager estimator negotiate contracts
advice_items.summary_en: Work a day job to learn the trade hands-on and study management, estimating, and contract negotiation at night.
advice_items.summary_zh: 白天打工实操，晚上学习管理与谈判

advice_items.quote: I love being outside um I love building something... I tried every other trade I love moving the earth
advice_items.summary_en: Try different trades and pursue the specific craft and work environment you genuinely love.
advice_items.summary_zh: 尝试不同行业后深耕自己真正热爱的领域

guests.first_money_or_break: 出身普通，24岁靠汗水股权创办挖掘工程公司，27岁成为百万富翁，28-29岁年营收达800万美元；31岁因2008年金融危机破产，休整两年后东山再起，花10年重建多家数百万美元规模的企业。
guests.wealth_detail: Became a millionaire at 27; first excavation company hit $8M/yr revenue before 2008 bankruptcy; rebuilt numerous multi-million dollar companies over 10 years
guests.zero_start_advice: 靠汗水股权白手起家，白天一线操作设备、晚上读夜校学管理预算与合同谈判；没人会来救你，必须自己拼命去干。

advice_items.quote: what you're going to learn in school is really really important okay what you learn in business you learn handson and you you got to learn it yourself
advice_items.summary_en: Value formal education, while recognizing that practical business skills must be learned hands-on by yourself.
advice_items.summary_zh: 学校教育很重要，但商业实战得靠自己学

advice_items.quote: if any great Trader tells you you never lost money then he's lying to you... there's a lot of loss that comes with it of course that's how you learn
advice_items.summary_en: Accept that taking losses is an unavoidable part of trading and investing—that is how you learn.
advice_items.summary_zh: 交易必经亏损，这正是你成长学习的过程

advice_items.quote: the middle class saves the upper class invests
advice_items.summary_en: Build wealth by investing rather than merely saving, as the upper class invests while the middle class only saves.
advice_items.summary_zh: 中产阶级只顾存钱，富裕阶层懂得投资

advice_items.canonical_tag: OTHER:Invest in Consumer Trends You Observe
advice_items.quote: invest by walking around so it's kind of like the Peter Lynch model... everyone in my house has an Apple product everyone in my house wears Lululemon
advice_items.summary_en: Follow the Peter Lynch model by observing popular consumer products and brands around you to find investments.
advice_items.summary_zh: 用彼得林奇法从日常消费观察中选股投资
